boot: pinned S3 rev0 ROM, ESP-IDF 5.5.2 second-stage bootloader, fixed factory partition
efuse: fresh 1024 bytes, byte 38 = 12 (official IDF S3 revision 0.3 recipe), otherwise zero
ram_option: fixed -m 32M follows IDF model recipe; fixture does not enable PSRAM
application: ordered CPU0 and CPU1 fixture markers, READY, exact BUILD, consecutive UART heartbeats
time: device clock unmeasured; no icount or enforced virtual budget; host timeout only
completion: no panic, exact native assertions, unforced exit zero after guest restart request with -no-reboot
timer_watchdog: QEMU timer.esp32s3.timg wdt_disable=true, not watchdog acceptance
diagnostics: bounded exact Flash legacy-ID/SFDP/resume and Xtensa DSRSET debugger-query limitations; no other rejected MMIO permitted
persistent_storage: private writable Flash/eFuse copies per run; original image unchanged
